name: White-Label Social Media Management
promise: Content calendars, design, captions, publishing and reports for your agency's clients.
intro: gaa-tha provides white-label and outsourced social media management for US and UK agencies and brands: monthly content calendars, post and carousel design, reels, captions, scheduling, community management and reporting for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok — delivered under your agency's name in US business hours.

glance.bestFor: Agencies with growing social retainers and brands without an in-house social team
glance.timeline: Strategy and first calendar in two weeks, then monthly
glance.model: Monthly retainer by number of brands, platforms and posts
glance.channels: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest

whatIs: White-label social media management means a partner plans, creates and publishes social content that an agency delivers to its clients under its own brand. The agency approves the work and owns the client conversation; the partner does the planning, design, editing, copywriting and scheduling.

gaa-tha already runs social media for brands in India and Canada, with content pillars, design, reels and community posts. For agencies we work in your approval tool and brand kits, write in American or British English to match the client, and deliver reports in your template.
included: Monthly content calendar built on agreed content pillars
Post, carousel and story design in the client's brand kit
Reels and short-form edits from client footage or stock
Captions and hashtags in US or UK English
Scheduling in Meta Business Suite, Later, Sprout Social, Hootsuite or Planable
Community management and comment replies during US business hours
Monthly performance report in your agency's branding
Paid social boosts coordinated with the ads team when needed

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.text: Brand kit, tone of voice, audience, competitors and approval process agreed under NDA.

steps.title: Pillars and calendar
steps.text: Content pillars and a month-ahead calendar for your approval.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: Designs, reels and captions produced in batches in your approval tool.

steps.title: Publish and engage
steps.text: Approved content is scheduled and comments are handled within agreed hours.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: A branded monthly report with what worked and next month's plan.

pricing: Monthly retainer custom-quoted by brands, platforms and content volume after a paid pilot month. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.q: What is white-label social media management?
faq.a: It is social media planning, content creation and publishing done by a partner that your agency sells under its own brand. gaa-tha does this for US and UK agencies across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok.

faq.q: Do you write in American or British English?
faq.a: Either. We match the client's market, spelling and tone of voice, and keep a style sheet for each brand.

faq.q: Can you use our approval tool?
faq.a: Yes. We work in Planable, Later, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Google Drive or whatever your agency uses for client approvals.
Yes. Comments and messages are handled during US business hours using an agreed response guide, with anything sensitive escalated to your team.

faq.q: Can you produce reels as part of social management?
faq.a: Yes. Reels and short-form edits are produced in-house from client footage, UGC or stock, and can also be bought as a separate editing service.
With a paid pilot month for one brand. You see the calendar, the content and the report before adding more clients.
